copy.tagline: 用 TypeScript 调用 Replicate 的 AI 模型推理与训练
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用 TypeScript 调用 Replicate 平台的 AI 模型。
copy.tagline_en: Call Replicate AI models for inference and training with TypeScript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call Replicate AI models using TypeScript.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 Replicate 的 npm 包在云端 GPU 上运行开源机器学习模型，比如生成图片、转录音频、运行大语言模型等。它会自动处理 API 调用、文件上传和结果获取。
howto.when: 当你提到“Replicate”、“replicate.run”、“replicate.stream”等关键词，或要求运行开源 ML 模型（如 Llama、Stable Diffusion）时触发。

say.text: 用 Replicate 的 flux-schnell 模型生成一张日落山景图。
创建一个异步预测任务，完成后通过 webhook 通知我。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you run open-source ML models on serverless GPUs using the Replicate npm package, such as generating images, transcribing audio, or running LLMs. It handles API calls, file uploads, and result retrieval automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'Replicate', 'replicate.run', 'replicate.stream', or ask to run open-source ML models like Llama or Stable Diffusion.

say_en.text: Use Replicate's flux-schnell model to generate a sunset mountain image.
say_en.note: Claude will call replicate.run() and return the image URL.

say_en.text: Stream Llama 3's explanation of TypeScript using replicate.stream.
say_en.note: Claude will use replicate.stream() for real-time output.

say_en.text: Create an async prediction with webhook notification on completion.
say_en.note: Claude will use predictions.create() with webhook setup.
